Find the coordinates $(h,k)$ of the center of the circle above given that the points $(5,3)$ and $(-1,-3)$ lie on a diameter of the circle.
feedback.worked_solution:
The center of the circle is located at the midpoint of the diameter. Therefore, we can calculate it using the midpoint formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}(h,k) & =(\frac{{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}}{2},\frac{{y}_{1}+{y}_{2}}{2}) \\  & =(\frac{5-1}{2},\frac{3-3}{2}) \\  & =(\frac{4}{2},\frac{0}{2}) \\  & =(2,0).\end{aligned}
$$
